verdict.rationale: Medusa provides storefront development guides and Next.js/Gatsby starter kits (medusa-docs-5, medusa-comm-9) plus GitHub-based deploys and PR preview environments (medusa-docs-1, medusa-docs-11, medusa-docs-35), which cover part of the version-controlled-deploy and preview aspects of the story. However, Medusa is headless — there is no documented 'templating layer' or theme system (it's a full custom React/Next.js app, not theme templates), and no explicit local-preview workflow documentation is cited. Missing for 10: a documented templating/theme abstraction layer, explicit local-preview tooling docs, and independent hands-on confirmation of the PR-preview/deploy flow.
